notes.title: Don't Get Eaten v0.04 UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]New content:[/b]

- New weapon!!! A [b]Grenade Launcher[/b] has been added to the game.
- New updated HUD.

[b]Bug fixes/balancing:[/b]

- Decreased firing delay for shotgun.
- Increased headshot damage with pistol.
- Increased cost of spike traps.
- Fixed issue where workbench and laptop could be used while using the settings menu.


Thank you to everyone supporting the game. I will continue working on it to make it more fun.

Thanks
Joel
NightForge Games

notes.title: v0.03 Update
notes.notes:
